integrity: Analytical proof for all n>=2; accompanying exact-rational and high-precision tests cover only finite index ranges. No independent audit or novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge metric on K_n with exactly one private leaf per core vertex, n>=2, real Hilbert target. General weighted coronas or multiple leaves are not settled. Historical priority is qualified by one inaccessible older distance-matrix paper.
title: Exact Hilbert distortion and simplex rigidity of whiskered cliques
